findings.text: Gemini 2.5 Pro reached the Frontier Safety Framework (FSF) early-warning alert threshold for Cyber Uplift Level 1, so Google DeepMind says it is accelerating cyber mitigations and higher-frequency testing.

source.quote:
we are putting in place a response plan which
includes testing models’ cyber capabilities more frequently and accelerating mitigations for them.

findings.text: On Research Engineer Benchmark ([RE-Bench](/evals/re-bench)), Gemini 2.5 Pro’s best runs scored between 50% and 125% of best human-written solutions but did not reach the machine learning (ML) R&D Autonomy Level 1 alert threshold.

source.quote: Gemini 2.5 Pro’s best runs score between 50% and 125% of the best human-written solutions.

findings.text: Divergence attacks succeeded roughly 69% of the time for Gemini 2.0 Flash + Flash-Lite and roughly 59% for Gemini 2.5; when divergence succeeded, memorization-classified text was roughly 0.2%.
